_comment: The templates this package ships, as data. A template is a *specification* for a new
drawing — a standard, a paper, an orientation, a plot scale and the title block's fields
— not a drawing to copy. `drawing_new(template=...)` applies it; the committed
`templates/*.dxf` are the artefacts the same specification builds, and
`scripts/build_templates.py --check` rebuilds them and compares a geometry fingerprint.
title_fields holds the title block's placeholder fields; the 比例 field is written from
`scale` at build time, so a sheet always states its scale (GB/T 10609.1). An empty string
is a field left for the draughtsman to fill in, which is what a template is for.
